name: Huldah (prophetess, wife of Shallum)
title: The Prophetess Who Confirmed God's Judgment
summary: Huldah was a prophetess in Jerusalem during the reign of King Josiah. She was consulted when the Book of the Law was found in the temple, and she prophesied about God's coming judgment on Judah because of their idolatry, while promising that Josiah would die in peace because he had humbled himself before the Lord.

keyEvents.title: The Book of the Law Is Found
keyEvents.description: When the Book of the Law was found in the temple during King Josiah's reign, the king sent his servants to the prophetess Huldah to seek the Lord's will.

keyEvents.title: Huldah Confirms God's Judgment
keyEvents.description: Huldah prophesied that the Lord would bring disaster on Jerusalem and its inhabitants because of their idolatry and turning away from God.

keyEvents.title: Promise of Peace for Josiah
keyEvents.description: Because Josiah had humbled himself and torn his clothes when he heard the words of the law, God promised through Huldah that he would be gathered to his fathers in peace before the judgment came.

keyEvents.title: Parallel account in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Huldah's prophecy is also recorded in 2 Chronicles, confirming her important role in the spiritual revival under Josiah.
